name: quality-loop
description: A three-layer quality loop for AI-generated code: a contract-driven unit-testing discipline (tests assert what the unit promises, never how it works — verified by mutation testing), a deterministic pre-PR gate running your local Semgrep CE install with your project's own rules, and critical triage of Greptile AI code reviews — closed by a human-approved ratchet that turns recurring findings into rules. Works with your own Semgrep install and Greptile account; ships no vendor code and no rules.
